headwords.text: To see or eat rye bread in your dreams, foretells you will have a cheerful and well-appointed home.
To dream of saddles, foretells news of a pleasant nature, also unannounced visitors. You are also, probably, to take a trip which will prove advantageous.

To dream of seeing a safe, denotes security from discouraging affairs of business and love. To be trying to unlock a safe, you will be worried over the failure of your plans not reaching quick maturity. To find a safe empty, denotes trouble.
headwords.note: 기존 상징 `cash-box`(금고, 밀러 별개 표제어 Cash Box에서 온 것)에 둘을 더한다 — 「금고가 비어 있음」은 같은 그림이 이미 있어 뺀다

headwords.text: Saffron seen in a dream warns you that you are entertaining false hopes, as bitter enemies are interfering secretly with your plans for the future. To drink a tea made from saffron, foretells that you will have quarrels and alienations in your family.

To dream of sage, foretells thrift and economy will be practised by your servants or family. For a woman to think she has too much in her viands, omens she will regret useless extravagance in love as well as fortune.
headwords.note: 새 상징 `garden-sage`(세이지, 허브) — 두 그림. 기존 상징 `sage`(성현, 주공해몽)와는 완전히 다른 뜻이라 term_en을 "garden sage"로 갈라 같은 상징으로 안 묶이게 한다

headwords.text: To dream of sailing on calm waters, foretells easy access to blissful joys, and immunity from poverty and whatever brings misery. To sail on a small vessel, denotes that your desires will not excel your power of possessing them.
headwords.note: 기존 상징 `sea`(바다)에 하나만 더한다 — 원문 각주 [196] 'See Ocean and Sea' 그대로. 「잔잔한 물에서 항해」는 기존 밀러 Ocean 표제어의 「바다가 잔잔함」과 같은 그림이라 뺀다

headwords.text: To dream of sailors, portends long and exciting journeys. For a young woman to dream of sailors, is ominous of a separation from her lover through a frivolous flirtation. If she dreams that she is a sailor, she will indulge in some unmaidenly escapade, and be in danger of losing a faithful lover.
